prompt: Desktop web app comp, 1440x900, flat 2D UI: a night-shift content-factory control floor for AI UGC production. Matte steel blue-grey enamel panels with visible seams and bolt heads; a faint hazard-yellow floor-tape grid runs under everything as the layout armature. A single continuous steel conveyor rail crosses horizontally through the vertical middle with a glowing amber job token riding it. Five station panels mount on the rail, left to right, each with a big stencil numeral and a status andon lamp: 01 INTAKE holds a vertical 9:16 phone viewport showing a reel transcript plus a context field; 02 ANALYZER shows a hook card reading pattern-interrupt, a three-row beat timeline with timestamps, and a diagonal red REMIX stamp; 03 STYLIST shows three garment thumbnails (floral dress, gold necklace, black heels) with green formality meter bars and chips playful / casual / mall; 04 EXPRESSION shows a rotary dial mischievous_grin and two andon lamps, green GENUINE lit and dark PERFORMED; 05 BRIEF DISPATCH shows a cream paper job ticket printed with hook, script outline and caption, stamped REMIX. Top edge: riveted header with dot-matrix LED counters BRIEFS 07, QUEUE 02, TAKT 04:12 and persona chip ARIA. Bottom edge: a bank of four knurled metal dials MOOD, DAY, ENVIRONMENT, PLACE above a green mono readout strip and an amber RUN LINE button. Palette: steel blue-grey enamel, cream paper, hazard yellow, amber signal glow, signal red, machine green. Industrial control-room aesthetic, dense and operational, crisp small UI text, no neon cyberpunk glow, no glassmorphism, no perspective, no people.
approvedBasis: Comp of record, not a user pick. Image generation was unavailable (insufficient account funds) during this build, so the three options were authored directly in code/SVG rather than generated. This conveyor composition is what actually shipped and was browser-verified at ugc-system/ui/app/page.tsx, so it carries the approval. The operator has not yet chosen between the three; they can re-roll or switch to the console or dispatch composition at any time.
disclosure: The two alternates (comp-console, comp-dispatch) were NOT rejected by the operator — they were never put to a vote. They remain live options.
riskNote: Conveyor-spine topology carries the factory metaphor hardest. The console's oversized focal ANALYZER beat ladder is folded in as station 02's treatment.
